title: Breaking AR’s Sampling Bottleneck: Provable Acceleration via Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: Develops information-theoretic convergence bounds for masked diffusion sampling. KL error depends on token dependence, sampling iterations, and predictor accuracy; matching upper and lower bounds characterize settings where fewer rounds than the sequence length can suffice.
summary.zh: 从信息论角度分析掩码扩散语言模型的采样收敛性，将 KL 误差与 token 间依赖、迭代轮数及预测器精度联系起来。论文建立匹配的上下界，刻画生成轮数少于序列长度时仍可获得准确采样的条件。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of Beyond Serial Sampling: Token dependence; KL error guarantees; Parallel sampling.
